execution_image.storage: One contiguous HOST_VISIBLE|HOST_COHERENT|DEVICE_LOCAL Vulkan storage buffer on the existing UMA memory type.

block148_layout.name: d_bits_fp16
block148_layout.semantics: Exact raw source Q4_K bytes 0..1; no float conversion during materialization.

block148_layout.name: scale_min_direct
block148_layout.semantics: For j=0..7: byte[4+2*j]=sc[j], byte[5+2*j]=mn[j], exact 6-bit logical integers expanded to uint8.

block148_layout.name: q_korder_pairs
block148_layout.semantics: For p=0..127: low nibble=q[2p], high nibble=q[2p+1]. q[k] is the exact logical 4-bit value decoded from source Q4_K layout.

materializer.execution_time: Exactly once before all arm warmups/measured blocks.
materializer.destination: Write directly into final mapped Vulkan execution-image buffer; no full-image temporary copy.
materializer.cpu_parallelism: Implementation may use the existing CPU threads for one-time materialization, but thread count is not a study factor and must be frozen before timing. Materialization time includes the chosen frozen implementation.
algorithm: For each target layer in frozen ascending layer order, each row 0..3583, each source block 0..73:
Decode source scale/min bitfields with the exact existing scale_min semantics and store direct uint8 pairs.
Decode each source q[k] as exact nibble integer and repack consecutive k pairs into q_korder_pairs.

logical_semantics_guard.canonical_block_tuple: d_bits16 || dmin_bits16 || for j=0..7(sc8,mn8) || for k=0..255(q8)
logical_semantics_guard.validator: Independently decode source block and EXEC148 block into the canonical tuple stream and require byte-exact equality for every block of all 14 tensors.
logical_semantics_guard.tensor_hash: SHA256 over concatenated canonical block tuples per tensor.
logical_semantics_guard.family_hash: SHA256 over the 14 tensor canonical streams in frozen layer order.
logical_semantics_guard.float_oracle: After tuple equality, component output must still satisfy max_abs <= 0.02 and RMSE <= 0.005.

serial_kernel_contract.work_decomposition: Exactly baseline Serial-K: one invocation owns one output row.
serial_kernel_contract.accumulation_order: For ib=0..73, kin=0..255, accumulate in increasing k order exactly as baseline.
serial_kernel_contract.weight_binding: Q4K_SERIAL_K_EXEC148_V0_1 buffer; w_base_bytes = layer slot base.
serial_kernel_contract.prefill: UNCHANGED baseline path using original model weights.

architecture_cost_semantics.extra_ram_bytes: 549,527,552 in the 4-arm harness because original model residency must remain for 0/A and unchanged prefill.
architecture_cost_semantics.format_only_expansion_bytes: 14,852,096 versus the source 14-tensor Q4_K payload; report separately and never substitute it for incremental resident RAM.
architecture_cost_semantics.materialization_time: CPU wall time from start of direct writes into final mapped buffer until all 14 images are complete and logically validated; validation time must be reported separately, not hidden inside materialization.

prohibited: No FP16/F32 full dequantized weight image.
No change to Serial-K ownership or accumulation order.
No layout search after measured performance is visible.
No changes outside the 14 Q4_K decode ffn_down nodes.
